title: Edu Ebook Reader: A DRM-free progressive web app for interactive 3D educational EPUB content
description: A local-first educational reading application for permitted DRM-free materials. Version 1.1 adds interface accessibility features (skip link, live section announcements, focus management, visible focus, contrast fixes, an accessibility-metadata panel) and improves EPUB 3 rendering (language and theme passed to content, full-width 3D pages, text-version fallbacks). DRM scope and sandbox are unchanged. The bundled demonstration EPUB includes a keyboard correction of its 3D viewer (5 November 2026). Version 1.1.1 respects PDF permission flags: page text is shown, searched or read aloud only when the PDF allows copying or extraction for accessibility.
